component.name: Pixee
component.summary: Browse and view your image files

description.p: Pixee is a fast, minimalist image manager. It browses folders as a thumbnail grid, opens images in a built-in viewer, and handles the everyday file work — copy, move, rename, delete — without leaving the window.

ul.li: Thumbnail grid backed by a local cache, filled in the background so browsing stays responsive
Viewer with fit / 1:1 / stepped zoom, panning, fullscreen and instant previous / next
In-viewer editing: rotate, flip and crop with a fixed-ratio marquee
Live colour adjustment — brightness, contrast, saturation, hue and gamma
Metadata panel, including the embedded text chunks that AI image tools write
Live histogram while browsing and while viewing
Background file operations with progress, conflict prompts and batch rename

description.p: Pixee reads and writes ordinary folders, so it fits alongside whatever else you already use — it keeps no library and imports nothing.
